title: Observations on the Sermons of Elias Hicks In Several Letters to Him; With Some Introductory Remarks, Addressed to the Junior Members of the Society of Friends.

Waln expresses alarm at what he sees as a growing impatience with established church governance, driven by an exuberance among younger members influenced by Hicks.
